title: Land of Evangeline Camping Resort

services.name: Cottage Rental
services.desc: Located at Evangeline Beach, Grand Pre, Nova Scotia. This Oceanview bungalow has 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom available for rent, with a 3 night minimum for booking. The cottage has 1 queen bed and 2 twin beds with open an concept living room, a fully supplied kitchen with a fridge, stove, microwave, coffee/Keurig machine, toaster, and dining area with a table and 4 chairs. We also provide an outdoor firepit with 4 camping chairs for your use, a propane BBQ including 1 x 1lb propane tank and the cottage has a large L shaped deck with a gazebo with a 6 person dining set.
